packageDocs.summary: Rose AI Companion: chat UI, agent runner, sessions, memories, and usage components. API-backed components call /api/rose/* route handlers (mounted by apps/rose and apps/test) and require an authenticated session. All API URLs resolve through roseApiBase()/NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL — if your host mounts rose routes elsewhere, pass the apiBasePath prop.
requiresEnv: NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL (optional — when rose routes are served via the API gateway)
Server-side (route handlers): SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_SECRET, GEMINI_API_KEY, GEMINI_MODEL, ROSE_* usage limits
assets: /rose/*.png — copy the rose assets folder into the host app's public/ directory (or set avatarUrl/image props).

RoseChat.description: Full chat application: session sidebar, chat pane, usage bar, memories modal trigger, and optional inline AuthModal (requireAuth=true). Integrates Chat + UsageBar + MemoriesSettingsModal automatically.
notes: Copy the /rose/* assets into host public/ or set avatarUrl.
apiBasePath resolves via roseApiBase() by default.

Chat.description: Presentational chat bubble view (messages, avatars, emotions, options, traces). No API calls.
notes: Defaults to /rose/happy.png — set avatarUrl if assets differ.

UsageBar.description: Shows today/weekly usage against limits and updates live via supabase Realtime. Fetches GET /api/rose/usage with the session bearer token.
requiresEnv: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (Realtime; skips gracefully when unset)
notes: Ships the rose-package usage-bar styles; see styles.css.

RoseChatModal.description: Compound, shippable modal wrapper around RoseChat. RoseChatModalProvider wraps the app and shares a single open/close state via context; RoseChatModal renders the full-screen overlay containing RoseChat, and RoseChatModalActionButton / RoseChatModalFloatingButton open that same modal (never a duplicate instance). Sidebar and header visibility are configurable via the RoseChat props it forwards.
notes: All triggers/overlay share one context — mount at most one RoseChatModalProvider (and one RoseChatModal) per tree.
Copy the /rose/* assets into host public/ or set avatarUrl.

MemoriesSettingsModal.description: CRUD modal for long-term memories (list/search/add/edit/delete) via /api/rose/memories*. Needs an access token (pass token prop or use inside an AuthProvider session).

Providers.description: Rose app provider: wraps children in @machi-asia/auth AuthGate so unauthenticated visitors are blocked while auth resolves. Optional authApiUrl prop.

MarkdownRenderer.description: Renders markdown/rich content with link/media/emotion support. Pure presentational.

ChatbotInputArea.description: Chat input with files/badges/slash-menu integration. Pure UI; forward input state via props.

ChatbotInputBadge.description: Renders a removable context badge (@project / @skill tokens).

ChatbotSlashMenu.description: Slash-command menu filtered by input, driven by DEFAULT_COMMAND_CATEGORIES.

ChatbotTraces.description: Collapsible list of agent traces/thinking steps.

ChatbotOptionsPicker.description: Renders the model's multiple-choice question + selectable options.

ChatbotWelcome.description: Welcome screen with starter prompts, quick commands, and reference badges.

roseApiBase.description: Resolves the rose API base: explicit arg > NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL + /api/rose > /api/rose. Use to keep all rose calls consistent.

roseApiUrl.description: Resolves a path against the rose API base, e.g. roseApiUrl("sessions") -> /api/rose/sessions.

roseGatewayUrl.description: Returns the trimmed NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL or empty string.

isBrowserSupabaseConfigured.description: True when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are set.
